chars.MILOUD: MILOUD: a skinny young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans with white sneakers.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young woman wearing a dusty-pink hijab scarf around her head and a long olive-green coat with a small beige handbag.
chars.FATHER: FATHER: an older man with a short grey beard wearing a white djellaba and yellow babouche slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny old-medina street in Tangier, SALMA suddenly stops and grabs MILOUD's sleeve with a very serious worried face; MILOUD turns toward her, nervous, sweating, eyebrows raised. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Walking side by side on a seaside corniche in Tangier at sunset, SALMA looks down nervously holding her handbag strap, MILOUD looks at her curious and a bit anxious.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: MILOUD in front of a traditional Moroccan house door with green zellige, holding a box of Moroccan pastries and a bouquet, shyly smiling; the FATHER opens the door, surprised and suspicious.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a quiet Moroccan cafe terrace with mint tea glasses on the table, SALMA sits facing MILOUD with her hand on her chest, very serious and sincere; MILOUD holds his tea glass frozen in mid-air.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close comic shot of MILOUD sitting at the cafe table, sweating a lot, eyes wide, biting his fingers, imagining the worst; little sweat drops fly around his head.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: MILOUD faces the viewer and shrugs with both hands open in a funny 'what do you think?' gesture, half smiling half panicked, on the Tangier street.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Comic imagination scene: MILOUD sits terrified while behind SALMA floats a big friendly-scary purple genie made of smoke with a cartoon grin; SALMA looks innocent and unaware.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Back at the cafe terrace, MILOUD leans forward with a pointing finger asking a question, suspicious; SALMA looks away, embarrassed, fidgeting with her scarf.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SALMA lowers her head guiltily and raises one finger as if saying 'one time'; MILOUD freezes in shock, his tea glass falling from his hand and spilling on the table.
